limitations: One exported counter sample per trace; Current compiler view revisited in a second replay.
Kernel/register/spill table is compiler statistics; no per-line live register profile collected.
Influence categories must not be conflated: register pressure influence is zero for these samples; producer L1 cache pressure influence is100.
Profiler times exclude CPU build/upload and are not clean promotion timing.
No new authored-pixel or Person acceptance witness.
